messages:
Ivy (CSE): Quick flag 1 GroveLabs just turned on orgwide document search across 4 product teams. Ingest jobs started this morning, and they're hitting embedding throughput limits. They asked about bulk ingest rate limits, dedicated ingest lanes, and renewal impact (their enterprise contract renews in ~45 days). cc @Ravi @Asha

Ravi (CS Ops): Details? batch sizes, model, qps? Are these realtime or backfill jobs?

Ivy (CSE): Two streams: realtime small batches (~50 docs/min) and a large backfill (2M docs over 48h). Using "embed-fast-xxl". Backfill runs 20k docs/hour, average text len ~1.6k chars. They've seen spikes where ingest slots saturated and some jobs retried. Reported cost concerns vs expected estimate.

Diego (Eng): Backfill looks like it's hitting our async ingestion queue and saturating batch workers. We can throttle backfill and route to a dedicated ingestion pool. Do they want predictable throughput (reserved workers) or cheaper burstable hosting?

Asha (AE): They're asking for predictable per-doc cost and an SLA for indexing latency. Renewal likely depends on proving cost/predictability for search product. I'll offer a 14-day Dedicated ingest-run/commit pilot if engineering says feasible.

Marta (Product): Product note: customers keep asking for "per-indexing-cost" estimates and a per-team quota UI. Collecting this as a roadmap input. Ivy, can you get a sample job id and the size distribution?

Ivy (CSE): Sample job id: gl-2026-backfill-09 (sanitized). Example payload snippet: ```json
{
  "job_id": "gl-2026-backfill-09",
  "model": "embed-fast-xxl",
  "batch_size": 1024,
  "documents": ["...text..."],
  "async": true
}
```

Diego (Eng): That batch_size is large for our current worker config. Immediate mitigation: reduce batch_size to 256 and increase parallel workers on a temporary dedicated lane. I can spin up a dedicated ingest pool but need infra signoff for quotas.

Ravi (CS Ops): I'll open ops ticket OPS-3342 to request a dedicated ingest lane and temporary quota bump. ETA for pilot lane provisioning ~24h after approval.

Ivy (CSE): They've also asked for per-team dashboards so each product team can see spend. They want the backfill to finish without causing production search latency regressions.

Asha (AE): I'll prepare renewal scenarios: 1) seat-tier + burst credits, 2) committed ingest pool (monthly) with overage pricing. Need an estimate of GPU hours for the 2M doc backfill. Diego can you estimate?

Diego (Eng): Rough calc: at current config embed-fast-xxl ~120 docs/sec per GPU if batch_size 256 and avg doc length. For 2M docs that's ~4.6 hours per GPU. But overhead + IO means plan for 12 GPU-hours to be safe. I'll provide a clearer estimate in OPS ticket.

Marta (Product): Also logging request: they want per-document metadata in audit logs (indexer-run id, team, original file id). Add to backlog.

Ivy (CSE): Action items: 1) Ravi -> OPS-3342 for dedicated lane + quota bump, 2) Diego -> sizing + worker config change PR, 3) Asha -> renewal pricing scenarios and pilot offer, 4) Ivy -> coordinate with GroveLabs contacts (tw@grovelabs.com, ops@grovelabs.com) and run a pre-pilot checklist.

Ravi (CS Ops): OPS-3342 created. Requesting quota bump to allow 8 dedicated workers for 48h.

ops-bot: Dedicated ingest lane "grovelabs-pilot-1" provisioned (expires 14 days). Resources: 8 workers, 32GB mem/worker.

Diego (Eng): Deployed worker config changes to canary pool. PR: github.com/redwood/infer/pull/7643. Will monitor ingestion metrics and post a dashboard link.

Ivy (CSE): Scheduling kickoff call with GroveLabs tomorrow 11:00 PT. Will capture initial pilot metrics (index latency, errors, cost delta) and post here. Renewal risk flagged: medium-high until pilot proves cost predictability.

Asha (AE): Thanks team. If pilot shows steady <15% cost delta vs estimate and no production impact, I'll recommend conversion to a monthly committed ingest pool at renewal. If not, we prep objections and mitigation notes for the renewal cycle. :handshake:
